layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.

Light: the sun is low in the south-west, at the bottom left of the image: faces turned to the left or to the viewer are lit, faces turned to the right are in shadow, snow is brightest on its left side, and nothing is lit from the right.

Class: one small calm terrain decoration for a strategy map, seen in three-quarter view looking slightly down, much smaller and less saturated than units, a thin dark outline, simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, no face. It sits directly on the empty transparent background: nothing is drawn under it, no ground patch, no soil disc and no shadow.

Subject: one tiny detail of a volcanic plain, each image a different one of these: a small crack in black basalt rock #3a3036 with bright orange lava #f07a2a and yellow #ffc03a bubbling up inside it; three glossy black obsidian shards #2a2240 with violet glints #8a6ad0 sticking up; a little round pool of bubbling yellow sulphur #e8d43a with a crusty rim of dark rock; a blackened charred ribcage and a horned skull lying on the ash; a small stubby rock chimney of dark basalt with orange embers #f07a2a puffing from its top; a little red fire salamander #d0402a with orange spots, curled. Small and low, about half of the image wide, much smaller than a person.
